The nearly 120-year-old newsstand and stationery store will close Dec. 31, owner Patti Bray said. Newspaper circulation will move across the street to the Bangor General Store.

data.status: opened its second location on Tuesday
data.short_description: Halal Bites opened its second location in the former Sharkey's restaurant in Binghamton's First Ward. The owners gutted the interior, removing the bar, expanding the kitchen and moving the bathrooms.
Halal Bites has operated on Riverside Drive in Johnson City since 2019. It will soon close that restaurant in favor of the new Glenwood Avenue location.

data.store_name: Silver Cross Health Center and Urgent Care
data.short_description: Silver Cross Hospital opened a new $20 million healthcare facility in Lemont offering urgent care, labs and imaging. It has 22 exam rooms, a full-service lab and an urgent care center.
The new center replaces the hospital's existing building on 127th Street, slated for demolition in the next six to nine months. The former site will be used for parking.
